what: Clorox makes household cleaning and consumer products: Clorox bleach and wipes, Pine-Sol, Glad bags, Kingsford charcoal, Hidden Valley dressings, Burt's Bees and Brita filters.
customers: American supermarkets, mass retailers and club stores, who stock the brands shoppers recognise.
money: cleaning products, wipes and professional cleaning
Glad bags, Kingsford charcoal and cat litter
Hidden Valley, Burt's Bees and Brita
moat: Brand names that have been the default for generations, which earns shelf space and lets the products hold a price premium over supermarket own-label.
risks: Revenue fell from $7.4B to $6.7B as shoppers traded down to own-label
A 2023 cyberattack disrupted shipments and cost a year of momentum
Analysts' average target is below the current price
opportunities: 18.9 times earnings with a 8.7% net margin after a long cost-cutting programme
$453M of free cash flow and a dividend raised for decades
Cleaning and bleach demand is about as steady as consumer demand gets
watch: Volume growth separate from price, which shows whether shoppers are coming back.
